_doc: Evidence-named variables for SPACE (lane mod-space). Key = DS address hex (A<base> for arrays, SUB<addr> for near subroutines); <key>_why = evidence. Unnamed addresses keep N_/S_/A_ names in the pseudocode. A<base>_count = element count of a static local array (evidence in A<base>_why); qb2bas renders every direct DS address inside an array range (COMMON descriptors or A<base>_count) as the element `Name(index)` - a constant index the compiler folded into a direct operand (sweep-folded, 2026-10-16); such addresses therefore carry no name key, only a _why.
